findings.headline: Import sharedConfig from solid-js/internal.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.1 drops sharedConfig from solid-js's public types; only solid-js/internal declares it, so this import is a type error.
findings.guidance: Move sharedConfig into an import from solid-js/internal and keep its alias. solid-js/internal is not public API and can change in any release, so if this is application code rather than a renderer or dev tool, look for a public API instead.
